components.name: Alert
components.summary: An inline message inside a page or form that explains something the user needs to know or fix.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A short status label (one or two words) with a dot, used in tables, cards and record headers.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Buttons trigger an action; use one primary button per screen region, for the thing that region is for.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A text input with its label above, optional helper text below, and an error state.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The left navigation rail shared by all three products — the one deep, dark block that makes them feel like a family.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: A KPI tile for dashboards: label, big number, and one line of context.

components.name: Table
components.summary: The main way records are shown in all three products: leads, tasks, employees.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switch between views of the same record (lead, project, employee) without leaving the page.
